{
  "anomaly_detected": true,
  "confidence": 0.8,
  "anomalies": [
    {
      "category": "wrong_value",
      "components": ["C2"],
      "pins": ["C2.1", "C2.2"],
      "nets": ["Display_Power_Switch", "GND"],
      "observed": "C2 is valued 1mF/6.3V (1 millifarad) on the EPD display power rail, and the SPICE deck models it as 1mF. That is 1000x the intended capacitance.",
      "expected": "The spec's EPD table gives C2 as 1 µF/6.3 V, the G1-group value that matches the Pervasive Displays reference. A 1 mF capacitor in an 0805 footprint is not physically plausible for this position.",
      "evidence": [
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(comp (ref \"C2\") (value \"1mF/6.3V\")"},
        {"source": "spec", "quote": "C2 default: 1 µF/25 V | C1/C5/C7/C8/C9/C10 = 1 µF/25 V | Matches default"},
        {"source": "spec", "quote": "C1 (G1 group only): 1 µF/6.3 V | C2 = 1 µF/6.3 V | Matches G1-specific value"},
        {"source": "spice", "quote": "C2 0 Display_Power_Switch 1mF"}
      ],
      "impact": "The 1 mF bulk cap on the display power node is oversized for an 0805 part and not a 1 µF decoupler. This changes the display rail's startup and charging behaviour and the boost converter's output filtering, and it may not fit or may be unobtainable in the specified footprint.",
      "confidence": 0.8
    },
    {
      "category": "wrong_value",
      "components": ["C1"],
      "pins": ["C1.1", "C1.2"],
      "nets": ["Display_Power_Switch", "GND"],
      "observed": "C1 is 0.1uF/16V on the Display_Power_Switch net, not the 1 µF/6.3 V G1-group capacitor the spec lists for this position.",
      "expected": "Per the spec's G1-group table, C1 should be 1 µF/6.3 V.",
      "evidence": [
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(comp (ref \"C1\") (value \"0.1uF/16V\")"},
        {"source": "spec", "quote": "C1 (G1 group only): 1 µF/6.3 V"}
      ],
      "impact": "Lower bulk capacitance on the display power node than the reference design uses, which may affect boost-converter output ripple and panel supply stability. The spec's table is internally inconsistent about which of C1/C2 carries the 6.3 V value, so this is less certain.",
      "confidence": 0.35
    },
    {
      "category": "footprint_mismatch",
      "components": ["C11"],
      "pins": ["C11.1", "C11.2"],
      "nets": ["unconnected-(C11-Pad1)", "GND"],
      "observed": "C11 is a capacitor (Device:C, value 0.1uF) but its footprint is an inductor land pattern, Inductor_SMD:L_0805_2012Metric_Pad1.05x1.20mm_HandSolder. Its pin 1 is also on an unconnected net.",
      "expected": "A 0.1 µF capacitor should carry a capacitor footprint such as the C_0805 pattern used for the other caps. Its pin 1 should be wired into the circuit or the part removed.",
      "evidence": [
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(comp (ref \"C11\") (value \"0.1uF\") (footprint \"Inductor_SMD:L_0805_2012Metric_Pad1.05x1.20mm_HandSolder\")"},
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(net (code \"59\") (name \"unconnected-(C11-Pad1)\") (class \"Default\")"}
      ],
      "impact": "The part may be placed in the wrong footprint or be a stray component. Its pin 1 is floating, so it provides no decoupling and it may cause a placement or assembly error.",
      "confidence": 0.3
    }
  ],
  "summary": "The EPD display power node carries C2 as 1mF where the spec and reference design require 1 µF, a three-order-of-magnitude error that is directly visible in both the netlist and SPICE deck. Lower-confidence secondary issues are C1's value and C11's mismatched inductor footprint."
}

anomalies.expected: Per the spec's G1-group table, C1 should be 1 µF/6.3 V.
anomalies.impact: Lower bulk capacitance on the display power node than the reference design uses, which may affect boost-converter output ripple and panel supply stability. The spec's table is internally inconsistent about which of C1/C2 carries the 6.3 V value, so this is less certain.

anomalies.observed: C11 is a capacitor (Device:C, value 0.1uF) but its footprint is an inductor land pattern, Inductor_SMD:L_0805_2012Metric_Pad1.05x1.20mm_HandSolder. Its pin 1 is also on an unconnected net.
anomalies.expected: A 0.1 µF capacitor should carry a capacitor footprint such as the C_0805 pattern used for the other caps. Its pin 1 should be wired into the circuit or the part removed.
